caption:
Saving it isn't doing it. ⚽

Same ball, two plans. One practices 10 minutes a day. One saves freestyle videos. Day 30, he drops it again. Next day, he kicks again. A year later: 200 touches vs 912 saved videos.

Listen to the rhythm change.

Send this to someone who saves everything.

#football #keepyuppy #practice #discipline #motivation
